changes: Added Android in-app update detection and GitHub Releases distribution, with release notes, download progress, installation permission handling and retryable errors.
Added native APK SHA-256, package identity, signing certificate and version verification; HTTPS redirects restricted to GitHub hosts.
Automated signed APK publishing through a draft release, upload verification and final publication; retained the existing signing identity and reduced temporary artifact retention.
Added shared product version information, animated DayLoop branding and expandable release history in desktop, mobile and Settings.
Redesigned the responsive guided tour with Back navigation, spotlight positioning and automatic Browse workspace previews.
Improved mobile navigation with a sliding active indicator, alphabetically sorted Browse entries and aligned streak history access.
Added categorized project banner and icon pickers, expanded appearance presets and project appearance browser test coverage.
Added reusable pagination to finance and transaction lists; improved mobile task row layout.
Restored dated habit check-ins, measurable inputs, skip and decline flows; reject future entries using habit timezone.
Improved habit status fallback for older APIs and seven-day insights.
Expanded server-side streak event history, grouped habit timelines, combined streak details and readable chart labels.
Added notification tap routing to tasks, projects, habits and calendar; canceled obsolete Focus reminders.
Removed the Focus workspace, timer, stopwatch and alarm, and updated landing, authentication and navigation references.
Updated documentation for Android releases, local SQLite data, security and validation.

Native background notification input, enhanced deadlines, encrypted backup automation, offline streak history and release retention automation remain pending; native updater installation and data preservation are not yet verified.
Introduced native Google sign-in bridge and Firebase Android signing configuration checks.
Hardened APK configuration, cleartext traffic and Android backup/data extraction restrictions.
Improved mobile API authentication, offline mutation synchronization, local data handling and identifier reconciliation.
Improved backend sync transaction cursors and insights handling; added PostgreSQL sync migration.
Added authentication smoke tests, mobile sync regression tests and PostgreSQL feed tests.
Updated Android documentation and internal non-debuggable APK signing workflow.
